$comment: Web reference sets: one capture per viewport, copied to every client dir listed. player-controls is taken by the web driver (playerControls) on the static server: clip paused at 2 s, video visible, focus dropped. pixels = expected PNG size (viewport x scale). mobile: phone layout (touch, mobile UA); otherwise the TV layout at that size. actionsTitle: the card the suite's long-press keys open on key-driven layouts (the second library card); touch layouts open the first card. crop: drop the extra pixel row the fractional scale produces. noDownloads: Downloads hidden in the web client (device cannot store downloads; Roku). extraScreens: ref-only screens that are not in suite.json (the device suites do not run them); each has an id and a route and is captured like a route screen. userAgent: the platform UA the web app keys on (android-tv shows Check for updates on profiles, android-mobile (phone only: the tablet layout opens a drawer on Calendar week with it) and xbox drop the hosted Clients link); a group with userAgents is captured once per UA, each for its own dirs (named <group>+<ua>). Unset = the driver default (Android TV on TV layouts, iPhone on phone layouts). Packaged webOS/Tizen builds are compile-time platforms the hosted build cannot select; they use the xbox UA. A userAgents key that is a packaged platform (tv-webos) is captured from a bundle built with that platform define (build-platform-web.mjs) and served on the private instance (PARITY_WEB_DIST_OVERRIDE of static-server.sh); it routes through the URL hash like the packaged app and is skipped by the default group list: name it with --groups tv+tv-webos. The dir tizen-webos holds both Samsung Tizen (web) and LG webOS: their web differs only in the playback engine (IS_TIZEN), so one webOS build serves both. hideVideo (group): the player-controls shot is taken with the video picture hidden (capture-web.mjs hideVideo convention: the picture is a codec and scaler difference, not UI). Only tv-harmony sets it, because the HarmonyOS Previewer cannot decode video; it is the xbox-UA TV capture for the harmony dir alone, so run it with --groups tv-harmony --screens player-controls --bak <name>.

tv-tizen65.$comment: Samsung Tizen 6.5 (dir tizen65): the tv-webos platform capture, player-controls shot with the video picture hidden because the Chromium 85 stand-in has no H.264. Run: --groups tv-tizen65 --screens player-controls --bak <name>. No other group lists the dir.
